profiles.notes: Fiji National University 2027 prospectus. Follow the named award, qualification and entry route.

requirements.label: Published campuses and delivery
requirements.details: The graduate programme entries list blended delivery at Nasinu, Namaka, Ba and Labasa. Campus offerings may change before enrolment.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50, 51

requirements.label: Postgraduate accounting background
requirements.details: Normally complete a relevant bachelor’s degree, graduate certificate or diploma in the subject or a related area. Appropriate work or professional experience can establish equivalent advanced knowledge and skills.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Degree for postgraduate Economics
requirements.details: Applicants need a completed relevant degree with GPA 3.0.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Business degree or head of school consent
requirements.details: Present a good bachelor’s degree in business or a related discipline with GPA at least 3.0 in Level 6 and 7 courses, or obtain special consent from the head of school.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Research skills and theoretical knowledge
requirements.details: The postgraduate entrepreneurship entry criteria also recognise exceptional research skills and theoretical knowledge in the relevant field.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Qualifications for the entrepreneurship master’s
requirements.details: Complete the Postgraduate Diploma in Entrepreneurship and Management, or hold a bachelor’s degree at GPA 3.0 or equivalent.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: Executive MBA management experience
requirements.details: The degree route requires a good bachelor’s degree in any field and at least three years in a middle management position.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: Executive MBA selection and alternative entry
requirements.details: The programme states that selection is first come, first served, with no cut-off on the number of new students. Alternative applications are assessed by the Executive MBA director and college dean.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: Academic entry to the research master’s
requirements.details: The listed routes are a postgraduate diploma with GPA at least 3.00 or a recognised equivalent, a bachelor’s degree with GPA 3.5, an honours bachelor’s degree with GPA 3.00 from a recognised institution, or a master’s by coursework.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: Research, coursework and honours routes to the doctorate
requirements.details: Present a research master’s, a coursework master’s at GPA 4.0 or higher plus a research methods course, or an honours bachelor’s at GPA 4.0 or above or with first- or upper-second-class honours. The prerequisites must be attained at a recognised institution.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.details: Pass Year 13 with 250/400 and at least 50% in English.

requirements.details: Pass the Fiji Year 13 Certificate Examination for the school-leaver route.

requirements.label: Customs progression and OCO/CCES applicants
requirements.details: The Level 5 Diploma in Customs is a listed qualification. Special consideration is offered to applicants who completed Certificate IV through OCO and graduated from CCES.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 40

requirements.label: Prior diplomas for the commerce degree
requirements.details: Prior learning through a diploma or a similar qualification may qualify the applicant for this combination of majors.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 46, 47, 49

requirements.label: Relevant diploma for Hospitality and Hotel Management
requirements.details: A diploma in the relevant field with GPA 2.8 is accepted. Applicants with a lower diploma GPA need three years of work experience.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

profiles.notes: Fiji National University 2027 prospectus. Follow the named award, qualification and entry route.

requirements.label: Economics entry from another discipline
requirements.details: Mature applicants holding a degree in another field need at least two years of relevant industrial experience and approval from the college dean.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Mature entrepreneurship applicants
requirements.details: Demonstrated ability to succeed can support mature admission under the award regulations or special consent of the dean.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 50

requirements.label: Discretionary master’s admission and progression
requirements.details: Maturity, work experience or prior learning can demonstrate readiness. The dean can set prerequisites, require specific or general examinations before enrolment, or prescribe courses that must be passed for further progression.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: CEO or manager route
requirements.details: A chief executive or manager with ten years of managerial experience in a successful business may apply through the experience route. Submit a job description, employment letter or contract, and a CV.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51

requirements.label: Evidence of professional research capability
requirements.details: The dean may assess qualifications or professional experience supported by research reports, dissertations, publications or other professional work demonstrating the knowledge and ability to undertake research and write a thesis.

source.title: FNU 2027 prospectus · Business, Hospitality and Tourism Studies · pp. 51
